storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP XLoveCam Downloader makes it easy to save live streams and recordings from XLoveCam.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any model page on XLoveCam while the stream is live, then open the popup or click the download button on the player. The extension detects the stream, shows available quality options, and lets you start a live capture. When you're done, click Stop and it saves as a standard MP4 file. For recorded videos, just select quality and download.

It handles LL-HLS streaming, Mouflon URI decoding, and CDN detection automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized XLOVECAM subfolder.

Key features:
- Live stream capture — start recording, stop when done, saves as MP4
- VOD download for recorded videos and trailers
- VR stream support with proper camera settings detection
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time download progress with segment count and elapsed time
- Right-click context menu for quick downloads
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to XLoveCam.com and open a model page while the stream is live
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and click Start — click Stop when done

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I capture a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any model page on XLoveCam.com while the model is live. Open the popup or click the download button on the player. Select quality and click Start. Click Stop when you want to end the recording.

faq.question: Can I download recorded videos too?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to a recorded video page on XLoveCam, and the extension will detect it as VOD content with a standard Download button instead of Start/Stop.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension parses the HLS master manifest for all available resolutions — typically multiple quality levels. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to an XLOVECAM subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Does this support VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR streams and includes proper camera settings metadata. A VR badge appears in the popup when VR content is detected.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding the stream?
faq.answer: Make sure the model is currently live and broadcasting. The extension needs an active stream to detect. If the model is offline or in a private show, the extension will show a status message.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
